describe: THE BATCH CLAIM — 3 of 4 positions settled in one transaction, 2.9 home
submittedBy: THE RELAYER — whoever this position belongs to never appears on chain as the sender

settlement.senderIs: the relayer — its KEEPER, unprompted. The local relayer runs with RELAYER_KEEPER=off, so this was the deployed one on Fly, which could only see the Markets address because the image finally ships evidence/ (commits 44c0909, 6eea5ce).
settlement.note: resolve is permissionless by design — settlement reads a public oracle and writes an answer that is a pure function of chain state, so a keeper that goes down cannot strand anyone's money. Nobody had to be trusted for this to happen, and nobody was asked.

headline: one transaction, one fee, three positions settled — and the losing rung filtered out before it could revert the batch and burn the fee for everyone in it
